subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86eb13fb31201ea1a28a56f0790ae677af0024430c317d9cf1aa450e912c9562.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 6 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 2, 3, 4 and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa86fd980ef291e93331dc5d23458f2c05cd0102976fae2d1349069a63b5a4fa.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 6

2 → 5

3 → 4

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "1".
